package.name: imagemagick-7
package.description: ImageMagick® is a free, open-source software suite, used for editing and manipulating digital images.

pipeline.name: Fetch the locked source commit
pipeline.runs:
git init -q .
for delay in 0 15 45; do
  sleep "$delay"
  for source in https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick.git; do
    if git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null -c fetch.fsckObjects=true fetch --no-tags --depth=1 "$source" a0c4bf729a26a5c2feb28b0365b47a8db736078a; then
      test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = a0c4bf729a26a5c2feb28b0365b47a8db736078a
      git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null checkout -q --detach a0c4bf729a26a5c2feb28b0365b47a8db736078a
      exit 0
    fi
  done
done
echo "a0c4bf729a26a5c2feb28b0365b47a8db736078a: every source failed, three times" >&2
exit 1

with.bins:
animate
compare
composite
convert
display
identify
import
magick
magick-script
mogrify
montage

pipeline.runs:
# Confirm HEIC format support
magick -list format | grep 'HEIC \+rw'

pipeline.name: Server-side document and image consumers
pipeline.runs:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
if magick -version | grep '^Delegates' | grep -E '(^| )(x|fftw|pango|gvc)( |$)'; then
    echo 'optional GUI/FFT delegate remains' >&2
    exit 1
fi
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
cd "$work"
# Scans, web thumbnails and phone photos are common document inputs.
magick -size 120x80 gradient:white-black scan.png
for format in jpg tif webp heic; do
    magick scan.png "scan.$format"
    [ "$(magick identify -format '%wx%h' "scan.$format")" = 120x80 ]
    magick "scan.$format" -resize 60x40 "thumb-$format.png"
    [ "$(magick identify -format '%wx%h' "thumb-$format.png")" = 60x40 ]
done
magick -font DejaVu-Sans -pointsize 24 label:'Invoice 123' text.png
[ "$(magick identify -format '%k' text.png)" -gt 1 ]
# Preserve PDF rasterization through Ghostscript for Paperless document imports.
magick scan.png invoice.pdf
magick -density 72 invoice.pdf invoice.png
[ "$(magick identify -format '%wx%h' invoice.png)" = 120x80 ]
echo 'PASS: JPEG/TIFF/WebP/HEIC, resize, font rendering and PDF rasterization'
